components.name: objective_success_bonus
components.condition: terminated and both legs contact and |x| < 0.1 and |y| < 0.1 and |vy| < 0.5 and |vx| < 0.5
components.description: One-shot bonus for successful landing on pad with low velocities, paid only at termination.

components.name: time_bonus
components.condition: terminated and success condition met and episode_length < 500
components.description: One-shot bonus for early termination (episode length < 500).

components.name: time_bonus_medium
components.condition: terminated and success condition met and episode_length < 750
components.description: One-shot bonus for medium termination (episode length < 750).

components.name: time_bonus_very_early
components.condition: terminated and success condition met and episode_length < 300
components.description: One-shot bonus for very early termination (episode length < 300).

components.name: distance_progress
components.description: Positive reward for being close to pad, scaled to max 0.5.

components.name: vertical_speed_progress
components.description: Positive reward for low vertical speed, scaled to max 0.3.

components.name: main_engine_penalty
components.description: Mild penalty for main engine usage, reduced when both legs contact to discourage hovering on pad.

components.name: orientation_engine_penalty
components.description: Very mild penalty for orientation engine usage, reduced when both legs contact.

components.name: crash_penalty
components.condition: terminated and not (both legs contact and near pad)
components.description: Strong penalty for crashing or going out of bounds.

components.name: time_penalty
components.description: Small per-step penalty to encourage speed.
